activity.title: I’m excited to share that our team won the 1st Place OpenAI Prize and Most Impactful Prize at Stanford TreeHacks 2026, the largest collegiate hackathon in the US! Alongside my teammates Nathan Z., Victor Chen , and Antonio Alonso-Stepanov , we built Mira ( https://lnkd.in/gKnzegA6 ), a multimodal AI agent that lives in your smart glasses and helps Alzheimer’s patients identify lost objects in 3D space, answer medical questions with clinical evidence, and alert caregivers in emergencies - just by voice. In 36 hours, we built Mira from scratch as a multimodal AI system combining voice interaction, NLP-driven reasoning, 3D vision, and web retrieval in real-time. We reconstruct rooms into 3D scene graphs from video, then combine multi-view detection, depth estimation, and camera pose to localize queried objects and translate those locations into both spoken directions and an interactive 3D point-cloud visualization. I’m looking forward to visiting the OpenAI HQ with my team to meet their researchers and discuss AI innovation. My experience at TreeHacks , competing alongside over 1,000 hackers from 30 universities and building with my team to tackle a real-world problem, has further reinforced my passion for building AI systems that create meaningful impact. I look forward to what’s next! #TreeHacks #OpenAI #Stanford #Hackathon #AI #MachineLearning ...more

Excited to see our project, ContinuuMed, featured by the Stanford Mussallem Center for Biodesign — and honored that it was awarded the Biodesign NEXT award and funding! We built an AI-powered discharge platform that generates personalized, easy-to-understand medical summaries from patient-nurse conversations and continues supporting patients after discharge through an interactive chatbot interface. The system helps bridge communication gaps between patients, caregivers, and physicians by acting as a trusted guide during the critical care transition period. What makes ContinuuMed special is its ability to handle the complexity of medical conversations while tailoring guidance to each patient’s unique situation — making care more accessible, reliable, and human-centered. Glad to have worked alongside Romal Mitr and Katherine Travisano , and grateful to Michelle de Haaff and Dr. Oliver Aalami for their invaluable guidance and mentorship! I’m excited to continue developing ContinuuMed and exploring how AI can empower patients and caregivers. #Stanford #AI #DigitalHealth #Biodesign #HealthTech ...more

Super excited to share that last weekend, my team and I won 2nd place at the 8VC + Meta Llama Hackathon! Big shoutout to my teammates Varun Madan , Jeff L. , and Krish Sharma . We created Priori AI, a local-first, privacy-preserving system to streamline the prior authorization process for physicians. In just 8 hours, we: 🧠 Performed edge optimization on a Llama model using quantization and pruning, enabling it to run fully on-device — no cloud, full patient privacy ⚙️ Built a dual-agent architecture using on-device inference and RAG-based policy matching that analyzes EHR data, flags documentation gaps, and iteratively refines and auto-generates compliant prior auth drafts — maximizing approval odds while preserving patient privacy 📊 Delivered real-time approval probabilities and concrete improvement suggestions 💡 Cut processing time from days to minutes And huge thanks to 8VC , Meta , and the hackathon organizers for hosting an incredible event. Excited for what’s next with Priori AI — and how we can continue using AI to solve real, meaningful problems in healthcare. #8VC #MetaAI #Stanford #StanfordEngineering #MachineLearning #EdgeAI #Llama #Hackathon #HealthcareAI #DigitalHealth #TechForGood #ComputerScience ...more

This past Sunday, I had the opportunity to compete in the Stanford University LLM x Law Hackathon hosted by CodeX, The Stanford Center for Legal Informatics , alongside 400 builders and 80+ teams. My team and I built ClaimHero, an AI-powered platform that helps patients navigate the health insurance appeals process from start to finish. Our tool analyzes denial letters, helps patients understand their coverage, predicts the likelihood of a successful appeal, generates personalized appeal letters, and even autonomously negotiates with insurers. We were honored to be selected as one of the top finalists at the event. ClaimHero empowers patients to confidently manage the health insurance appeals process–making it clearer, faster, and more accessible through the use of AI agents and automation. A big shoutout to my teammates Julia Ascoli , Kai Sheng Loh , Jason Gutierrez , and Avis Chan . Thank you to Jay Mandal and Dr. Megan Ma for hosting this incredible event and the fantastic bootcamp, and thank you to our mentor Dan Szabo for your guidance and support! ...more
